name: week
title: Grant team weekly review
subtitle: Applications, award balances and reports requiring a decision

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select name,owner,issue,due_on from grant_attention order by due_on nulls last

sections.title: Reports due
sections.sql: select g.name,t.title,t.due_on,t.owner from tasks t join grants g on g.id=t.grant_id where t.kind='report' and t.completed_on is null

sections.title: Evidence gaps
sections.sql: select name,issue,reference from evidence_gaps order by name

sections.title: Category budgets
sections.sql: select name,currency,category,budget_cents,actual_cents,planned_cents,available_cents from budget_variance order by name,category
